title: Provenance entry
description: One line of a venture's provenance log (<venture>/provenance.jsonl, EE-031), after W3C PROV: the entity (a record file) was generated by an activity, attributed to an agent (a person or an AI agent), derived from other entities, under a decision. The log is append-only: each line carries the hash of the line before, so an edited or deleted line breaks the chain. Git history is the implicit provenance for anything written outside the log. schema/check-provenance.mjs checks it.

entity.description: The file written, relative to the venture folder (prov:Entity); for a record kept in another source (EE-037), its address <source>://<path>

route.description: The route the write went through, when it went through the router

activity.description: write: written in place. draft: an agent's write to a gated record, held in _drafts/, or any write to a source that takes writes by pull request, held there until the pull request is merged. accept: a person accepted a draft. baseline: a record that existed before the log, adopted with its current content (prov:Activity). confirm: a person confirmed one guiding statement in the record, by typing its id (EE-051); the content is unchanged. move: a file moved to a new path; derived_from names the old path. release: a set of moves recorded as one release. publish: an artifact's built output went out on a channel (entity is the output, the decision names the publish decision). rollback: the previous version was restored merge: a person (or a role a delegation grant allows) applied a decided decision version to the records it decides; the decision file is the entity.

kind.description: unverified: a door with no sign-in (the console) said a person acted; the id is a claimed name

id.description: A person's name or handle, or an agent's role id from the team plan

session.description: A link or id for the session that acted

harness.description: The agent harness, such as Claude Code or Cursor, as it named itself

via.description: The interface the write came through

derived_from.description: What the content came from: venture-relative paths, URLs or decision ids (prov:wasDerivedFrom)

decision.description: The decision or decision class the activity acted under, such as EE-026 or ownership-or-control

source.description: For a record kept outside the venture folder (EE-037): the source it was written to, its version there, and the commit or pull request that holds it

id.description: The source id from the venture's knowledge/sources.json

version.description: The git blob SHA-1 of the content as written

pull_request.description: The pull request that accepts the write when it is merged

sha256.description: Hash of the file's content as written

prev.description: The previous line's hash, or genesis for the first line

hash.description: sha256 of prev followed by this line without its hash field, as JSON with sorted keys

statement.description: confirm only: the id of the guiding statement confirmed (purpose/guiding-statements.json)
